name: Paribus
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to redeemFresh, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step DeFi exploit involving an Aave flash loan, token swap into PBX, minting a Camelot LP NFT, entering an NFT collateral market, and then borrowing across several Paribus markets before unwinding. It requires understanding protocol-specific NFT-collateral/accounting logic and coordination across multiple contracts, but the execution path is still fairly direct once the core bug is identified.
